div.p: Welcome to my super cool corner of the internet! I’m Harman, but yea mostly people call me Hira 💎

I was born in Chandigarh, India, but when I was in my early 20s, I moved to the awesome island of New Zealand. I finished my studies in India and even got a diploma in Business Management and Leadership in New Zealand.

Guess what? When I was just 15, I got my very first computer! But instead of playing games like everyone else in my friend circle, I started coding. I got super interested in web development and even made cool web templates that I sold for a good price. I also had a tech blog where I made some money through Google Adsense, and get this, I was only 16 at the time! Oh, and by the way, I never studied IT in school at all and learned myself.

But then, when I moved to New Zealand, things slowed down for a bit. I had a full-time job (not in the IT industry, but delivering pizzas) and was also studying. But later on, I realized that coding was what made me happy. It's like a relaxation therapy for me. So, I started learning more on YouTube and stuff. I even made a few software related to hacking, but I regretted it and deleted them.

Nowadays, I'm still learning more and more about new computer technologies while working full-time in a different industry. If you're wondering why still in a diferent industry? Well unfortunately, if someone puts too much pressure on me to develop something, I can't do it. Coding is fun for me not a job.

Right now, I'm living a happily married life (my wife is sitting right next to me huh!). I love watching movies, traveling, learning new things, and of course, food! I'm a big food lover, and guess what? Besides coding, I'm also pretty good at making food.
That's a little bit about me!
